content.visible_text: Skip to Content About Schedule Youth Program FAQs Contact < back Senior Muay Thai Coach Brandon Play 00:00 00:55 Mute Enter fullscreen % buffered Competition Experience: Amateur fights: 7 Semi-Contact Matches (MDL/PKB): 20 USMTO national tournament finalist, 2023 Coaching Experience: 5+ years of Muay Thai coaching at CMA IKF licensed coach and for adult and youth competitors Youth Muay Thai Program Director Corporate Workshop Program Director Brandon's journey in martial arts began at age 14 under Coach Joe at Crispim BJJ in Pleasanton, CA, and continued as an adult in San Francisco. Brandon is Thai Boxing Association Level 1 certified and played a key role in running the youth program. Now at CMA, he teaches both beginner and intermediate adult classes, leads the youth program, and is a vital member of the fight team. Brandon combines his experience in wrestling and caring for others to maintain an approachable and comprehensive demeanor for all students.
